subject: Runway stability check — stage clarifications & commit lock
body:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ramirez <sofiar@brighttail.com>, Julian Park <j.park@brighttail.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Runway stability check — stage clarifications & commit lock

Hi Sofia / Julian —

Quick note ahead of our forecast lock in 72 hours. Finance is running a coverage sanity check for Q4 and we want to make sure BrightTail's open opportunities are reflected correctly in the commit review. Could you confirm the following for each open deal by EOD PDT today?

- Current CRM stage and firm close date (if changed from what’s in the snapshot)
- If there’s an approved PO or signed SOW (attach if available)
- Decision owner and any outstanding gating items (legal, budget holder, technical trial)
- Your explicit commit flag: "Commit" (expected close and PO/SOW in place) or "Best Case" (likely but not approved) or "Upside"

I attached a one-page pipeline snapshot and a CSV that maps our current CRM stages to the proposed commit classification — please update or annotate where we’ve mis-mapped anything. If you can’t do a full pass, just confirm the top three deals (BRIGHT-341, BRIGHT-342, BRIGHT-355) and indicate whether they should be included in the committed coverage for next quarter.

We’re trying to avoid overstating coverage in the forecast — finance will treat anything not explicitly flagged as "Commit" with conservative weighting. We’ll run a quick commit review tomorrow morning to finalize numbers.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0194

Attachments: pipeline_snapshot_20260914.xlsx (spreadsheet, 1 sheet) ; commit_matrix_20260914.csv (CSV, 1 file)

---

From: Sofia Ramirez <sofiar@brighttail.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Julian Park <j.park@brighttail.com>
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Runway stability check — stage clarifications & commit lock

Hi Vanessa —

Thanks for the clear asks. Quick responses for the three deals you called out:

- BRIGHT-341: Close date moved from 09/30 to 10/14. We have a signed SOW from procurement (attaching stub: "BRIGHT-341_SOW_signed.pdf"). Decision owner: Julian Park.
- BRIGHT-342: Still in legal review; expected PO by 10/01 but no signed docs yet. Class: Best Case.
- BRIGHT-355: Pilot completed, awaiting C-level approval. No PO yet — Upside.

I attached the SOW for BRIGHT-341 and a short note from legal on BRIGHT-342 that explains the remaining items. We’ll update HubSpot today with the commit flags you asked for.

One question: your commit matrix marks deals in "Procurement" as Best Case by default. If a signed SOW exists (but no PO), do you want that escalated to Commit for your review?

Sofia Ramirez
Head of Data & Analytics | BrightTail
sofiar@brighttail.com | 415-777-0210

Attachments: BRIGHT-341_SOW_signed.pdf (stub), BRIGHT-342_legal_note.docx (stub)

---

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Runway stability check — stage clarifications & commit lock

Looping in finance/ops for visibility — summary from BrightTail: BRIGHT-341 is the only one with a signed SOW (attached), though the close slipped to 10/14. BRIGHT-342 is legal (Best Case) and BRIGHT-355 is an Upside.

Immediate recommendations:
- Treat BRIGHT-341 as a soft Commit for coverage calculations but apply a 90% weighting until PO is in-hand.
- Mark BRIGHT-342 as Best Case (50% weight) unless legal confirms a PO will be cut this week.
- Exclude BRIGHT-355 from committed coverage (Upside) for the lock.

Connor — can you validate the weighting logic in the attached commit_matrix_20260914.csv and flag if we should be stricter? I’ll prep the numbers for the commit review and highlight BRIGHT-341 as the only near-term convert.

Thanks,
Ben
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Runway stability check — stage clarifications & commit lock

Thanks Ben — small operational asks from Finance to keep the lock clean:

- Please set HubSpot commit flag to exactly one of: Commit / Best Case / Upside (no free-text) so the export feeds cleanly into the forecast model.
- For any deal marked Commit, attach the signed contract or SOW in the deal record (PDF stub is fine).
- If close date slides beyond the quarter boundary, mark as "Next Quarter" in the close date reason field so we can exclude it from the current quarter coverage automatically.

I’ll run the commit reconciliation tomorrow at 8:30am PT. Ben — if you can push the BRIGHT-341 PO confirmation by EOD we can include it at higher weight. Connor — please build the conservative coverage number (70% weighting for signed SOW without PO, 50% for Best Case) and share the export before 8:15am.

Laura Bennett
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com

---

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ramirez <sofiar@brighttail.com>, Julian Park <j.park@brighttail.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Runway stability check — stage clarifications & commit lock

Appreciate the fast replies, everyone. Concrete plan:

1) BrightTail: please update HubSpot commit flags to Commit / Best Case / Upside and upload the SOW for BRIGHT-341. If you can push for PO confirmation today, notify Ben directly.
2) Connor: run the conservative coverage export with the agreed weights (70% signed SOW/no PO, 50% Best Case) and share before 8:15am PT tomorrow so Laura can reconcile.
3) Finance/RevOps: we’ll treat BRIGHT-341 as soft-commit at 70% pending PO, exclude BRIGHT-355.
4) Vanessa/Ben: if PO for BRIGHT-341 arrives by EOD, we’ll reclassify to 100% commit and include in the final locked forecast.

I’ll run a 30-minute commit sync tomorrow at 8:30am PT to finalize any edge cases — calendar invite to follow. Thanks all for moving quickly on this.

Best,
Vanessa
Director, Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
